video_title: Wemby Calls Out Luka for "Stat Padding" right After Stat Padding

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's dominant performance against the New Orleans Pelicans
quotes.excerpt: When a stat like that come across, I feel like that should be on the whiteboard.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: When a stat like that come across, I feel like that should be on the whiteboard before they played them. They beat us 13 out of the last 14 times. Fix it.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: How though? Like, Wembanyama had 50 and 19.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's unique playing style and physical presence
quotes.excerpt: He would make me crash out. I would feel so soft.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: That is one of them games I was talking about. It is like, what you want me to tell you? But this what you should have said in advance. But this guy jumping up, shooting, shooting dunks. I am not going to lie though, Wembanyama will make you do some, he would make me crash out. I would feel so soft.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: That is what I am saying. It is like, you are someone who is trying to go across the middle, like, you know what, fuck him.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's non-aggressive but highly effective scoring
quotes.excerpt: He is not playing dirty, he is not pushing much, he is just scoring.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: During the season, he just be hooping. He is not playing dirty, he is not pushing much, he is not doing much of nothing like that. He just scoring.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I noticed though, Wembanyama slick. He is not dirty, but at the same time, he is not trying to clean the game up.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's reaction to reaching a 50-point milestone
quotes.excerpt: Unlike many of my peers, I am not very good at stat padding.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: What I say? He is not trying to clean it up.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: He is not trying to clean it up. He is going to turn around real fast, you might get slapped in the mouth, he is going to turn around real quick, you might get hit with the elbow.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: But sometimes he is really not trying to, you are in the way of his limbs. The guy has got limbs. Everybody is always in reach. And he constantly falls.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: And he constantly falls. Like, never fight him. I would just advise the rest of the league and the rest of the world, never fight him. You are always in range to get popped in your mouth and you are not close to hitting him yet.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's perspective on his high-scoring performances
quotes.excerpt: He can go out, get 50, 19, four and five, and that is just another day at the office.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: He just means, like, you know, I am not looking to do this. This is a byproduct of what you get with me. Basically he is saying like, I do not have to be told, I do not have to tell myself like, go out and get shifty. He can go out, get 50, 19, four and five, and that is just another day at the office.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Do he know that Luka is averaging 40? And shooting in the high 40 clip? What the fuck stat padding is that? I am confused. I will be the first to tell him, hey Wemby, I will be the first to tell you when somebody is stat padding.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: The necessity of high-scoring games for the Los Angeles Lakers
quotes.excerpt: They need him to score 40 or his lights out.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I am just saying like, I do not get how he could be stat padding. They need him to score 40 or his lights out.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: That is the thing. You have already come to realization with that. Most of us, people like that brand of basketball, they have come to that realization that the Lakers need him to be that way in order to be successful at all.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Advice to Victor Wembanyama regarding his comments on stat padding
quotes.excerpt: Hey Wemby, it is cute. Do not poke that bear.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Hey Wemby, it is cute. Do not poke that bear. I am letting you know now. Then he might, he might stat pad for 60 nigga.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: He might. He might. That is it.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Hey matter of fact, Wemby go at him. I want to see the 60. I want 60.
